THC-v3: Preserve completed THC tuner: any nonfinite warmup OR retained trajectory, undefined required IAT or invalid gradient denominator makes the block/full score undefined. Rejected numerical proposals retain the previous valid state.
NUTS mean adaptation statistic is not a Metropolis acceptance probability; report it separately from THC acceptance.
Same seed identifiers and physical starts in corresponding blocks. Original RNGs are preserved: NUTS uses Numba thread-local legacy NumPy RNG; THC uses SeedSequence child streams. Individual random draws are NOT claimed to match. Pairing hashes seal starts, seeds and run lengths, not common random draws.
No final-data parameter selection. NUTS adapts only within the discarded warmup of each chain.
